notes: Per its tooltip Zephyr only reduces AoE damage, so it was used only for raid-wide damage (Fishy Feedback, Pop!, Unending Tides) and movement after Guillotine; whether soaks (Mutilate, etc.) count as AoE attacks is unconfirmed, so Obsidian Scales was written for them

The Hover lines are based on the tooltip 'allows casting while moving, except empowered spells'; Scalecommander and Flameshaper-only spells (Mass Disintegrate, etc.) were not included, and the damage school that breaks the Gravebound Advance shield was not mentioned

Season 1: Per its tooltip Zephyr only reduces AoE damage, so it was used only for raid-wide damage (Void Breath beam DoT, Midnight Flames, Shattered Sky); the Rescue line is based on the tooltip 'Clears movement impairing effects from you and your ally'

Season 1: The Wing Buffet line connects s1.json Mythic Fractured Image 'can also be knocked back' and Safeguard 'remove with knockbacks' to the tooltip 'knock away enemies in front of you'; Cauterizing Flame was connected to Black Miasma (Curse) and Expunge to Poison Burst (Poison)
